name: bubble-bash
description: Bubble Bash, a phone-first bubble shooter. Plays in any browser; wrapped with Capacitor for the App Store and Google Play.

scripts.build: mkdir -p www && cp index.html www/index.html && cp -r icons www/
scripts.ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
